amendments.title: Data start 2013-01-02 → 2012-12-03
details: §3 says the data start is chosen "so the W=504 windows exist at 2015-01". From 2013-01-02 there are only ~492 KRX trading days before 2015-01-02, which contradicts that stated intent.
With the earliest fetched date (2012-12-03), 508 return rows precede 2015-01-02. The first two rows are dropped because no US/FX observation strictly precedes them.

amendments.title: US HY OAS → Moody's Baa−10Y spread
details: FRED now serves `BAMLH0A0HYM2` only from 2023-10-09 (ICE licensing). That leaves the warm-up and most of the sample empty.
Replaced by FRED `BAA10Y`, the long-history credit-spread series on FRED (2012-12-03 onward). It is lagged strictly before each KRX date like the other US series.

amendments.title: KOSDAQ 150 index before 2015-10-01 → KOSDAQ composite (`^KQ11`)
details: §2 planned the KOSDAQ 150 index from pykrx. KRX index endpoints now require a login: pykrx and FinanceDataReader both fail with `LOGOUT`/`KeyError`.
The composite is the closest freely available series. It is a price index, so dividends are omitted only for 2012-12 to 2015-10.
